captures.title: Bidirectional Missions board — agents read it to self-prioritize
captures.note: Today the board is a read-only operator view; the fleet gets work from inbox + sequence DAG, not the board. Raised 2026-06-10; net-new capability (also relevant to the sibling project). Possible future phase: make the registry a prioritized backlog the fleet queries before pulling from its inbox.

captures.title: Orphan lane: show desktop chat title (fallback repo/branch), not the alphanumeric task_id
captures.note: Desktop orphans render desktop-<id> which is unreadable. Capture the Claude Code session title (needs a desktop_session_active re-emit since the title appears after a chat starts; verify the hook exposes it) and render title > repo/branch fallback in OrphansLane instead of the humanized task_id. Phase 2.

captures.title: Orphan lane: show STATE + collapse terminal orphans (97 noisy, can't tell what's done)
captures.note: Lane shows ALL unregistered tasks (terminal + active) with no phase, so 97 items look actionable when most are done. Fix: derive each orphan's phase, badge it (building/in-review/shipped/abandoned), and collapse/hide terminal ones so only actionable orphans show. Pairs with the Phase 2 derive-relocation. Auto-registration + register/dismiss buttons = Phase 3.

captures.title: Projects (PM layer) data is stale — separate system from missions GC
captures.note: The Supabase projects table (migrated from Mission Control) is NOT fed by the chain_events spine, so the missions GC healer never touches it. Its staleness needs its own freshness/cleanup mechanism. Track separately from the Missions tab; do not fold into missions GC.

captures.title: Operator Action Queue is full of benign/auto-handled alerts (101) — fix at the source
captures.note: The /api/operations/action-queue surfaces ~101 NOW items that are mostly already-handled (auto-restarted services the healers fixed, days-old unreviewed-merges, credential-drift, sync-blocked). Violates the alert-toil principle (only irreversible/ambiguous should reach Larry). Fix at the SOURCE: auto-silence/reconcile benign alerts (same direction as Medic auto-silence rollout) so the queue — wherever it lives (Approvals/Operations) — shows only genuinely-actionable items. Removed from Missions tab 2026-06-10; this is the deeper source fix.

captures.title: Register DESKTOP_INGEST_TOKEN in the credential registry (closes a NOW alert)
captures.note: Phase 0 added DESKTOP_INGEST_TOKEN to ~/credentials/.env.larry but not to the credential registry the system tracks, so it fires a recurring credential-drift:MISSING_REGISTRY_ENTRY:DESKTOP_INGEST_TOKEN NOW alert. Add it to the registry (config/ on the droplet) so the alert clears. Loose end from our own Phase 0 wiring.

captures.title: Decide full-codebase-audit cadence
captures.note: Phase-2 convergence avg novel-share 40% over 1 audit(s). SCHEDULE recurring audits — the corpus is still learning new bug classes, so regular audits keep teaching the gate. See memory mirror-bughunt-gate-project.

captures.title: Bug-hunt Phase 2: run the next full-codebase audit (cadence decision then auto-fires)
captures.note: Phase 2 distillation loop shipped 2026-06-10 (PR #426, on main). DEFERRED open thread: whether to SCHEDULE recurring full-codebase audits vs keep them on-demand. This card is the standing reminder of that thread. Trigger you control = running the next full-codebase audit. When one lands: distill_detector DMs you to run 'python3 review/distill/run_distill.py' -> audit_cadence_signal then auto-fires the schedule-vs-on-demand decision with REAL convergence data (and drops its own card). No action needed until you choose to run that audit. NOTE: dismiss the earlier stray 'Decide full-codebase-audit cadence' card (fake 40% test data from a dry-run). Context: memory mirror-bughunt-gate-project.
